title: ListenConfig::addr has no doc, example, or default
description: ListenConfig::addr in both transit/src/config.rs and reader/src/config.rs is declared as 'pub addr: String' with zero documentation. An operator setting up either daemon for the first time has no idea: what format addr takes (IP:port? hostname:port? IPv6?), whether port 119 is a default or must be explicit, or whether 0.0.0.0 vs 127.0.0.1 has security implications. Add a doc comment with: format ('IP:port or [IPv6]:port'), typical values for production ('0.0.0.0:119') and development ('127.0.0.1:119'), and a note that port 119 is the NNTP standard.
